mainEntity.name: What is a Studio ADU and how does it differ from other ADU types?

acceptedAnswer.text: A Studio ADU (Accessory Dwelling Unit) is a compact, self-contained living space that typically combines sleeping, living, and kitchen areas into one room, with a separate bathroom. Unlike 1-bedroom or 2-bedroom ADUs, a studio maximizes space efficiency in a smaller footprint, often making it more affordable and quicker to build. This design is ideal for single occupants, short-term rentals, or as a dedicated home office. When considering a Studio ADU, it's important to assess your property's available space and zoning regulations, as these factors will influence the maximum size and placement of the unit.
acceptedAnswer.description: A Studio ADU is a compact, self-contained living space with combined living/sleeping/kitchen areas and a separate bathroom. It differs from larger ADUs by its efficient, open-concept design, suitable for smaller properties or specific uses.
